ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65% low-intensity black pixels and 35% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in lateral mid-sections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous blobs located in the mid-region of both the left and right lobes, surrounded by a low-intensity black border at the tips, trailing edges, and central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for both lobes sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered within the white high-intensity regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the left lobe white patch and horizontally on the right lobe patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of circular scarring consistent with barnacle colonization and linear rake-like abrasions across the ventral surface pigment.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown pixel clusters within the high-intensity white regions, suggesting possible diatom accumulation.
